title: TOGETHER Jesus Dogs Outreach Night
seo_title: TOGETHER Jesus Dogs Outreach Night in Joplin, MO
description: TOGETHER Jesus Dogs Outreach Night is a monthly block party held as a church with no walls, where people come to serve, give, pray, worship and offer help with food, clothes, haircuts, hugs and prayer. Kids can play and get their face painted, pets get water and treats, and dog and cat food is available to take home. It takes place Friday, November 27, 2026 (time TBD) at 501 W 4th St in Joplin, MO; helpers can arrive for set up at 6 PM, with the outreach running 7 to 9 PM.
